note: LA.37b: every Dart member body is credited to its owner. HEAD: visit_top has no arm for mixin_declaration, extension_declaration or extension_type_declaration and visit_enum never reads enum_body, so none of their members is emitted; visit_class_member emits a METHOD only for a function_signature and walks every function_body with `acc.nodes.last()` as the caller, so a getter / setter / constructor body is credited to whatever node was pushed last - the previous method, or an ENDPOINT (HEAD emits CALLS warm -> GET /boot and GET /boot -> GET /status). Named extensions, mixins and extension types are CLASS nodes; an unnamed extension on a type this file declares hangs its members on that type; one on a type declared elsewhere is skipped (counted), never an invented node.
